sources.quality_notes: Reopened first-party catalogue: 214 04979, one fascicle, twelve lines, Qing manuscript, reports 1570 preface and Cao Rong postface; undated Zhang Ji note mentions another catalogue manuscript with relationship explicitly unknown. No target catalogue folio viewed or independently bound; received eight-juan title transcription separately located, not text of listed work. No original-glyph authority.

Adjacent 1902 colophon concerns Jiang yun lou, not Wan juan tang. Distinct catalogue locator from Kuraishi; exact physical impression relationship, target folio and lineage unverified.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: 1570 preface is not a dated surviving copy or composition date of the listed Ziwei manual.
1903 imprint statement and 1919 parent publication do not establish individual impression date.
Three catalogue records do not constitute three independent ancient text witnesses; eight-juan, six-juan and three-juan manuals not equated.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Original catalogue target folio and preface in identified copies.
Relationship of Qing manuscript, received electronic texts, 1903 edition and 1919 collection; identity of listed eight-juan manual.
